wwo.name: Cape Town
wwo.method: Selected street and land-use relationships along Bo-Kaap, the central gardens, Woodstock and the former shore. Thom's sheets supply the Table Valley garden approach, the street along the Woodstock railway district, its yard accesses and the landward constraint along the railway embankment. Brink's 1901 compilation supplies the two basin outlines and adjoining old shore and is used for supplementary streets and dock ground. Centre lines are approximate. Building dimensions and locations along streets are inferred within mapped frontage groups. Survey blanks and areas without readable access remain outside the traced network.

sources.licence: Historical geographic observations only. Municipality scan and service imagery excluded.
sources.precision: Municipal CRS84 rendering at 0.00002 degrees per pixel. Centre lines and boundaries read manually across the core, Table Valley and Woodstock windows. Registration between editions, individual sheet dates, paving and parcel detail are unresolved.

Brink depicts both harbour basins and the earlier coastal edge. Along Woodstock the water edge stays seaward of the mapped Thom railway embankment. The plotted Salt River marsh and the exact tidal contact remain approximate.
Mapped landward coast and dock works with a dry strip at the surveyed Thom railway embankment. Limits of tidal conditions remain unresolved.
Brink labels the dock area. Storage forms are inferred on the working harbour strip. Individual firms and cargoes are unresolved.
